<?php
/**
 * Background Job Worker with Feature Flag System
 * Processes queued jobs with dynamic configuration overlay
 */

class FeatureFlagStore {
    private array $flags = [];
    private array $overrides = [];
    private array $immutablePaths = ['worker.sandbox'];
    
    public function __construct(array $defaults = []) {
        $this->flags = $defaults;
    }
    
    public function get(string $path): mixed {
        $keys = explode('.', $path);
        $current = array_merge($this->flags, $this->overrides);
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!is_array($current) || !array_key_exists($key, $current)) {
                return null;
            }
            $current = $current[$key];
        }
        return $current;
    }
    
    public function applyOverride(string $path, mixed $value): void {
        // Check if path falls under any immutable prefix
        foreach ($this->immutablePaths as $immutable) {
            if (str_starts_with($path, $immutable)) {
                return;
            }
        }
        $keys = explode('.', $path);
        $ref = &$this->overrides;
        foreach ($keys as $key) {
            if (!isset($ref[$key]) || !is_array($ref[$key])) {
                $ref[$key] = [];
            }
            $ref = &$ref[$key];
        }
        $ref = $value;
    }
}

class JobContext {
    public array $metadata = [];
    public FeatureFlagStore $features;
    
    public function __construct(FeatureFlagStore $features) {
        $this->features = $features;
    }
}

class JobWorker {
    private FeatureFlagStore $featureFlags;
    private array $handlers = [];
    private array $jobConfig = [
        'max_retries' => 3,
        'timeout' => 30,
        'sandbox' => true,
        'allowed_classes' => ['stdClass', 'DateTime'],
    ];
    
    public function __construct(array $featureDefaults = []) {
        $this->featureFlags = new FeatureFlagStore($featureDefaults);
    }
    
    public function registerHandler(string $type, callable $handler): void {
        $this->handlers[$type] = $handler;
    }
    
    /**
     * Process a job message from the queue
     * Message format: {type, payload, config_overrides}
     */
    public function processMessage(string $rawMessage): array {
        $message = json_decode($rawMessage, true);
        if (!$message || !isset($message['type'])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'invalid_message'];
        }
        
        // Apply per-job feature flag overrides from message
        if (isset($message['config_overrides']) && is_array($message['config_overrides'])) {
            $this->applyConfigOverrides($message['config_overrides']);
        }
        
        $context = new JobContext($this->featureFlags);
        $context->metadata = $message['metadata'] ?? [];
        
        return $this->executeJob($message['type'], $message['payload'] ?? [], $context);
    }
    
    private function applyConfigOverrides(array $overrides): void {
        foreach ($overrides as $entry) {
            if (!isset($entry['path']) || !isset($entry['value'])) {
                continue;
            }
            $path = $entry['path'];
            // Validate path contains only allowed characters
            if (!preg_match('/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.]+$/', $path)) {
                continue;
            }
            $this->featureFlags->applyOverride($path, $entry['value']);
        }
    }
    
    private function executeJob(string $type, array $payload, JobContext $context): array {
        if (!isset($this->handlers[$type])) {
            return ['status' => 'error', 'reason' => 'unknown_handler'];
        }
        
        $sandboxEnabled = $this->resolveSandboxMode($context);
        
        if ($sandboxEnabled) {
            return $this->executeSandboxed($type, $payload, $context);
        }
        
        return $this->executeSandboxed($type, $payload, $context);
    }
    
    private function resolveSandboxMode(JobContext $context): bool {
        // Feature flag can disable sandbox for specific job contexts
        $flagValue = $context->features->get('worker.sandbox.enabled');
        if ($flagValue !== null) {
            return (bool)$flagValue;
        }
        return $this->jobConfig['sandbox'];
    }
    
    private function executeSandboxed(string $type, array $payload, JobContext $context): array {
        // Sandboxed execution - restricted unserialize, no eval
        $handler = $this->handlers[$type];
        $allowedClasses = $this->jobConfig['allowed_classes'];
        
        if (isset($payload['serialized_data'])) {
            $payload['data'] = unserialize(
                $payload['serialized_data'],
                ['allowed_classes' => $allowedClasses]
            );
        }
        
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'result' => $handler($payload, $context)];
    }
    
    private function executeUnsandboxed(string $type, array $payload, JobContext $context): array {
        // Unsandboxed execution - full capabilities (dead code, never called)
        $handler = $this->handlers[$type];
        
        if (isset($payload['serialized_data'])) {
            $payload['data'] = unserialize($payload['serialized_data']);
        }
        
        return ['status' => 'ok', 'result' => $handler($payload, $context)];
    }
}

// Worker initialization
$worker = new JobWorker([
    'worker' => [
        'sandbox' => ['enabled' => true],
        'logging' => ['level' => 'info'],
    ]
]);

$worker->registerHandler('process_report', function(array $payload, JobContext $ctx) {
    return ['processed' => true, 'id' => $payload['report_id'] ?? 'unknown'];
});

// Simulate processing from queue
$queueMessage = file_get_contents('php://stdin');
if ($queueMessage) {
    $result = $worker->processMessage($queueMessage);
    echo json_encode($result) . "\n";
}
